charts.title: TOI-2458 b: orbits around TOI-2458
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2458's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2458 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Šubjak et al. 2025 (2025A&A...693A.235S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SUBJAK_ET_AL_2025): P 3.73659 d

charts.title: TOI-2458 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2458 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (32, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 449197831, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 474 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 475 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 474 min late; 9-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 158 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
